summary: You can roll a Conditional Access policy out step by step, with a preview and safety checks.

new.title: Move policies through stages with buttons
new.text: A SuperAdmin can now move an adopted Conditional Access policy one stage at a time, from off through pilots to production, or back. Each move first shows exactly what changes.
new.action: Run the install again after this update, so the engine gets the permission the stage buttons need.

new.title: Safe moves, checked and recorded
new.text: A move that enforces a policy needs your confirmation. The suite checks the policy first, refuses unsafe moves, keeps break-glass accounts excluded, and records every move in the policy's history.

new.title: Nothing changes a policy by itself
new.text: No schedule, job, monitor or template update ever changes a Conditional Access policy. Only a move you approve does.
